strategy.summary: The static todo app (public/app.js) already implements completing via checkbox, All/Active/Completed filters with aria-pressed, and a "Clear completed" button hidden unless a todo is completed. The tests must prove, in a real browser against the real server, that ticking/unticking toggles the strike-through and "items left" count, each filter shows exactly the right todos and is shown pressed, and Clear completed appears only while something is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
Visibility and effect of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js, used here only as setup)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; the ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: Nothing is faked: the app is static files served by the real server.js, which Playwright's existing webServer config starts; there is no API. All state lives in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list and is independent.
Todos are created through the UI (the label 'What needs doing?' and the Add button), as the existing spec does.
'Struck through' is asserted as the computed text-decoration-line 'line-through' on the todo's title, which styles.css applies to li.completed span.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others, as app.js sets it.
List contents are asserted as the exact ordered list of titles (toHaveText on the list items), so an absence is checked against a list that is known to be rendered.

risks.description: Items-left count or strike-through not updating on untick (state toggled one way only)
risks.mitigation: TC2 ticks then unticks and asserts both the style and the count return.

risks.description: Filters showing the wrong subset or the pressed state not following the selection
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC6 use a mixed list and assert the exact visible titles and aria-pressed on all three buttons.

risks.description: Clear completed removing only one completed todo or active ones too
risks.mitigation: TC8 completes two non-adjacent of three todos and asserts exactly the active one remains.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: its title is struck through and the 'items left' count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
The Active filter shows only todos that aren't completed, Completed only those that are, All shows every todo, and the selected filter button is shown as pressed.
'Clear completed' is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decreases items left by one
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is checked and its title has text-decoration-line line-through; 'Walk dog' is not struck through; count reads '1 item left'.

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
steps: Tick 'Buy milk' and see '1 item left'
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox is unchecked, its title has text-decoration-line none, count reads '2 items left'.
testCases.rationale: AC1 requires the reversal; a one-way toggle is a common bug.

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is shown pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active has aria-pressed=true, All and Completed aria-pressed=false.
testCases.rationale: Active filter subset and pressed state.

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is shown pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed has aria-pressed=true, All and Active aria-pressed=false.
testCases.rationale: Completed filter subset and pressed state.

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is shown pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All has aria-pressed=true, Active and Completed aria-pressed=false.
testCases.rationale: Returning to All must show completed and active todos.

testCases.title: ticking a todo while the Active filter is selected hides it from the list
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog'] and Active stays pressed.
testCases.rationale: Filter must react to a state change made while it is selected.

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add 'Buy milk'; check the list shows it and the button is hidden
Tick 'Buy milk'; check the button is visible
testCases.expected: The 'Clear completed' button is hidden with only active todos, visible once one is completed, and hidden again after unticking.
testCases.rationale: The 'appears only while' half of AC3, including the reverse transition.

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; count reads '1 item left'; Clear completed button is hidden.
testCases.rationale: Proves all completed todos are removed (not just one) and active ones stay.

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173); Chromium must be installed. No env vars or seed data.
